name: Earthjustice
summary: Earthjustice appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The bill no state can shield).

mentions.section: The bill no state can shield
mentions.excerpt: In a separate federal proceeding, Earthjustice argued on April 24 that no commenter could name the penalty that would make a customer with virtually unlimited capital and strict uptime contracts cut its draw when the grid runs short.

sides.sideLabel: The bill no state can shield
